proposition: Search is optimized for throughput over latency.

provenance.excerpt: Jev publishes 250k input tokens per second and 1,200 requests per minute; both can change without notice. A full search request is about 15k tokens, so 16 fills the token budget. The request cap is looser.
Listings are rendered once. Each proposition contributes one Noul per directory, on that same state, so the oracle can fill a request with questions from many propositions.
